definitions.gloss: raw cotton; cotton fiber; cotton boll
definitions.explanation: The fluffy white fiber harvested from cotton plants, used as a raw material for textiles. Refers to cotton in its unprocessed or minimally processed state.

notes:
The raw cotton fiber from cotton plants. Composed of ⟦{綿|めん}→綿：03807_men⟧ (cotton) + {花|か} (flower/blossom), referring to the fluffy boll that resembles a flower. Specifically refers to unprocessed cotton as a crop or commodity.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {綿花|めんか}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{栽培|さいばい}→栽培：13108_saibai⟧: cotton cultivation
- {綿花|めんか}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{収穫|しゅうかく}→収穫：03207_shuukaku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to harvest cotton
- {綿花|めんか}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{輸入|ゆにゅう}→輸入：01742_yunyuu⟧: cotton imports
- {綿花|めんか}{畑|ばたけ}: cotton field
- {綿花|めんか}⟦{相場|そうば}→相場：07668_souba⟧: cotton market price

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{綿|わた}→綿：00421_wata⟧: cotton, padding — the everyday word for cotton; also used for cotton batting and padding
- ⟦{木綿|もめん}→木綿：01738_momen⟧: cotton (fabric) — processed cotton cloth; the material used for clothing
- ⟦{真綿|まわた}→真綿：20422_mawata⟧: silk wadding — despite containing ⟦{綿|わた}→綿：00421_wata⟧, this refers to silk, not cotton

CULTURAL NOTE:
Japan imported significant quantities of raw cotton during industrialization. Today, Japan imports nearly all its cotton. Historically, cotton cultivation was important in regions like ⟦{大阪|おおさか}→大阪：09779_oosaka⟧ and the {瀬戸内|せとうち} area.
